observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a large, dark solar panel with a grid of photovoltaic cells.
The panel has a black frame and appears to be made of monocrystalline or polycrystalline cells, given the uniform dark color and grid pattern.
The surface is reflective, showing distorted images of people and surroundings.
The panel is standing upright on a dirt ground, next to other similar panels.
No brand name, model number, or technical specifications are visible on the panel itself.
The watermark 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' is present on both photos, suggesting a seller or distributor.
The panel appears to be new or lightly used, with no visible cracks or damage in the photos.

No inverters, batteries, or charging equipment are shown in the photos. The claim is not supported by visual evidence.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially defective, with lower value due to unverified condition.

Close-up photo of the panel surface under bright light to check for microcracks or damage.
Photo of the panel's edges and frame to check for wear or previous installations.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
